summary: Genshin Impact entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Genshin Impact

emulation.notes: Use the current native or official release route where available.

primary.why: The Windows release has scalable settings and clean capture, while PlayStation and Xbox provide the other major platform routes. PC is the best fidelity-first primary unless a console-only account constraint applies.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows build through HoYoverse/Epic/official PC distribution, install the latest assets, and record the game version because regions, quests, events, and platform support change over time.

all_releases.fidelity: Scalable PC graphics/capture route with current live-service content.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity and capture flexibility for the same account-based game.

all_releases.fidelity: Native mobile route with full live-service access but lower capture/fidelity ceiling.
all_releases.reason: skip: complete portable route, not the best fidelity path.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PlayStation release, but PS4 content updates ended after April 8, 2026.
all_releases.reason: skip: historical platform and no longer the best supported/fidelity route.

all_releases.fidelity: Strong console route with 4K/load-time features, but less flexible than PC for capture/moderation of settings.
all_releases.reason: skip: excellent fallback but no sourced exclusive story/mission content over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Official Xbox Series X|S release dated November 20, 2024.
all_releases.reason: skip: current console route, but PC remains the capture/fidelity primary.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive story/missions require a secondary route; the main caveat is changing live-service content and platform support.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service events rotate, and PlayStation 4 support/content updates ended after April 8, 2026 per PlayStation's page; record the game version/date for archive captures.
